svg.title: GERD decision chart: classic heartburn or regurgitation without alarm features is a clinical diagnosis treated with lifestyle change then acid suppression; alarm features or Barrett's risk factors send the patient to endoscopy; failure of a PPI or diagnostic uncertainty leads to ambulatory pH monitoring and manometry
